name: Republic of Karelia (Karelian SSR, 1990–1993)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Карельская ССР / Karjalan SNT' in Russian and Finnish in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Karelian ASSR with the bilingual inscription changed after the sovereignty declaration of 9 August 1990. It was replaced on 16 February 1993 by the red, blue and green tricolour.

features.role: inscription 'Карельская ССР / Karjalan SNT' in Russian and Finnish
